name: bkny-brawler
description: Open source browser beat 'em up template with rollback netcode, Docker, Kubernetes and Agones.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @bkny/server" "npm run dev -w @bkny/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bkny/client && npm run build -w @bkny/server && npm run build -w @bkny/edge
